# Understanding Rust console window behavior (2025-06-13 22:53Z)

_**User**_

whats this do

---

_**Assistant**_

This line is a Rust attribute that configures how the application's console window behaves on Windows.

`#![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")]` means:

- When the application is built in release mode (`not(debug_assertions)`), it sets `windows_subsystem = "windows"`, which tells the Windows operating system to run this as a GUI application without showing a console window.
- In debug mode, this attribute isn't applied, so a console window will appear, which is useful for seeing debug output.

This is a standard pattern in Tauri applications to ensure that when users run your released app, they don't see an unnecessary command prompt window alongside your GUI.
